item.title: Off the Menu 2.0.2
item.description: 2.0.2 — PLAY AS THE WHOLE HERD. The herd selection is now unmistakable: the selected hero's card in THE HERD wears a thick gold border, the main menu names your selected hero and their special, and the NEW GAME button names them too. NEW GAME starts the run as the selected hero with their real stats (Pip: HP 60, speed x1.35, SENTRY). Selection persists across restarts in herd.json; loading a save still starts as the SAVE's hero, not the current pick. Jax remains the default on a fresh profile.
